cases.prompt: Apple 最新一季營收多少？
以 initiating-coverage 為 owner，整理 NVDA 10-Q、IR、consensus 與 source ledger。
以 initiating-coverage 分析 RKLB；先做一輪 bounded two-stage Seeking Alpha scan：先用 Ask SA 做 recall，再收集 decision-relevant structured data，最後驗證重大主張。

must_do: complete the core evidence-or-gap coverage gate
must_not_do: force all twelve inventory groups into reader-facing output
treat Ask SA as direct proof

cases.prompt: Public Equity Investing owner 正在復盤 RKLB 今日大漲及其投資論點影響；請先做 bounded Ask SA scan，讀取相關 Seeking Alpha structured data，並驗證重大主張。

must_do: separate company-specific evidence from market and positioning context
return the evidence pack to the owning workflow
must_not_do: treat price appreciation as thesis proof
pass the raw Ask SA response as the final answer

cases.prompt: Ask SA 沒有回覆，但 Seeking Alpha symbol page 的 estimates 與 ratings 仍可讀。

must_do: use accessible structured data when relevant
must_not_do: classify all Seeking Alpha as unavailable

cases.prompt: Seeking Alpha estimates 可讀，但 revisions、surprises 與 Quant history 沒有顯示。

must_do: record an explicit gap for each missing core group
continue with a limited evidence handoff

cases.prompt: Initiating coverage 還沒完成自己的 fair value；先收集 Seeking Alpha evidence。

must_do: exclude target price, implied upside, and target history from the pre-freeze request
record deferred_until_owner_fv_freeze when target data is required
must_not_do: use a provider target to anchor independent fair value

cases.prompt: Owner 已凍結獨立 fair value，現在讀 Seeking Alpha Wall Street target 做比較。

must_do: preserve analyst count and horizon when exposed
compare without revising owner fair value by default
must_not_do: replace independent underwriting with provider consensus

cases.prompt: 只查 NVDA 的 Seeking Alpha Wall Street target、analyst count、horizon 與 as-of；不要做估值或投資判斷。

must_do: collect the explicitly requested target evidence without requiring an owner FV freeze
preserve provider provenance, analyst count, horizon, and as-of
must_not_do: defer the standalone request behind an underwriting gate
infer fair value or investment action

cases.prompt: 對 40 檔股票做初步 screen，並用 Seeking Alpha 補資料。

must_do: scan only priority names, outliers, and decision-critical securities
record the selection rule and material exclusions
must_not_do: collect all twelve groups for every security

cases.prompt: 兩家 provider 的 EPS consensus as-of date 不同。
用我提供的 Seeking Alpha Portfolio 匯出與 Ratings 截圖整理 evidence pack。

must_do: keep Quant, SA Author, and Wall Street ratings separate
must_not_do: promote provider evidence to primary issuer evidence

cases.prompt: 幫我做 DCF 並決定建倉比例。
